title: Rabbi Yohanan bar Maryah—Marya—Madya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman places him in R’ Mana’s time, citing Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:6: R’ Mana said, “Throwing is like pouring”; Rabbi Chananyah said—[his statement is elided]—Rabbi Yochanan bar Madya said, “A verse supports Rabbi Chananyah.” At the beginning of Peah, chapter 1 [2b in Hyman’s citation], he reports in R’ Yochanan’s name; in Pesachim 6:2, in R’ Pinchas’s name. He is also mentioned in Terumot, beginning of chapter 11; Bikkurim 3:4; Shabbat, chapter 3, end of halakhah 1; Eruvin 6:1; Megillah 1:2; Sanhedrin 6:9; Bereshit Rabbah 13:5; and Vayikra Rabbah 23:9.
Hyman says he was expert in calculating intercalation, citing Avodah Zarah, chapter 1, end of halakhah 1.

notes.text: The source repeats the Peah locator. The compressed break after “Rabbi Hananiah said” remains; no missing opinion or attribution connector is supplied.

The whole saved Venice Pesachim5:6 scalar1 distinguishes THROWING, זריקה, from SPRINKLING, הזייה. Mana says throwing is like pouring; Chananyah says throwing is like sprinkling; Yochanan bar Madya cites a verse supporting Chananyah. Hyman elides Chananyah’s opinion, so it is explained here rather than imported into his quotation. Full Rabbi for Yochanan and Chananyah is local to the named supporting clause, not transferred to Mana or unrelated citations. Maryah/Marya/Madya and named מדייא remain distinct. Peah’s repeated רפ״א־ב: stays in the Hebrew and the2b reading is conventional, not newly edition-verified. Calendar expertise and contemporaneity remain Hyman’s claims.

Hyman’s print (vol. II, pp. 682–683) has מריא in the Pesachim narrative beside the supplied מדיא and the consulted מדייא. It leaves Chananyah’s view unstated. The consulted Pesachim 5:6 spells out the difference between Mana’s pouring comparison and Chananyah’s sprinkling comparison, then gives Yochanan’s scriptural support for Chananyah. The print repeats the Peah locator across a page turn. The consulted Peah 1:1 has מריא reporting in Yochanan’s name, and Bereshit Rabbah 13:5 has מריה. In Avodah Zarah 1:1 the consulted text calls him מדייא and quotes his calculation that the date had not fallen on Shabbat. The broader description of his expertise is Hyman’s.
